steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Technical skills are the specific physical competences that enable a dancer to perform movement accurately and safely | Key Fact: Posture is the way the body is held and provides the base from which all movement begins | Key Fact: Alignment refers to the correct positioning of body parts in relation to one another, ensuring efficient movement | Key Fact: Control is the ability to manage the body's movement with precision, including speed, direction and dynamics

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from technical dance skills, and one past-paper question.
